title: Your Life in the Yakuza at Every Rank (You Owe a Finger)
hook: Neon bleeds over wet asphalt outside the club's back door. Your knuckles are open — not from throwing anything. A detective who's chased your name for eleven years stands close enough to arrest you, and doesn't. Somewhere behind you, someone isn't getting up.
body: POV: recruited off a stairwell into a fictional, composite yakuza gumi, you climb its real, documented hierarchy — kobun to wakashu to shatei to shatei-gashira to shibucho to wakagashira to oyabun to kumicho, supreme boss of the whole syndicate. Real, verified mechanics woven in: the sakazuki sake-cup ceremony that formalizes every rank; yubitsume, the finger-joint atonement ritual; irezumi, the hand-poked tebori tattoo that can run 200–600 hours; jonokin, the tribute that kicks up the chain every week; the real 2015 Yamaguchi-gumi/Kobe-Yamaguchi-gumi split that fractured Japan's largest syndicate into a running gang war; and the real collapse in NPA-reported membership — down roughly 90% from a 184,100 peak in 1963 to about 17,600 in 2025, as Japan's exclusion ordinances quietly did what a decade of police work never could: no bank account, no apartment lease, no way to spend what you control. This episode's gumi, syndicate, and named characters are a FICTIONAL COMPOSITE — no real, currently active organization or living individual is depicted. Watch the whole series — every life, every level, every rank the world doesn't forgive. For educational and entertainment purposes.
pinned: Real fact: yakuza membership has collapsed roughly 90% since its 1963 peak of 184,100 — not mostly from arrests, but from Japan's 2009–2011 exclusion ordinances, which quietly ban banks, landlords, and hotels from doing business with a listed member. Which rank do you think breaks people first — the tattoo, or the finger?
poll: Which rank breaks you first? RANK III (200 hours of tattoo needle to become 'made') / RANK IV (laundering your own crew's money through concrete) / RANK VI (the split — your mentor excommunicated, then dead) / RANK VIII (kumicho — $340M moves through you, $0 is actually yours)
